headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, with AI emerging as a key driver.
summary: Most listed firms reported double‑digit revenue gains YoY. TCS and HCLTech highlighted expanding AI revenues, crossing 10% of total sales for TCS and jumping 78% YoY for HCLTech. Profit growth was mixed; Tech Mahindra posted the strongest YoY profit rise, while Persistent saw a sharp decline. Dividend payouts remained stable across the sector.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: AI revenue is rising fast, contributing to higher margins and new deal wins.

themes.title: Steady revenue expansion
themes.detail: Revenue grew in double digits for most majors, supported by strong service demand.

leaders.why: 15.6% YoY profit rise and 21.2% YoY revenue growth, the strongest top‑line expansion.

laggards.why: Profit fell 25.4% YoY despite revenue growth, indicating margin pressure.
